title: Pure Valkyrie
summary: Valkyrie cards only, with generic Links and staples. Valkyries are LIGHT Fairies that hit hard on your turn and then skip the opponent's. Ride of the Valkyries summons any number of different Valkyries from the hand. Mischief of the Time Goddess, at the end of your Battle Phase, skips straight to the Battle Phase of your next turn. Valkyrie Dritte searches any Valkyrie card, and Valkyrie Sechste summons another Valkyrie from the Deck when it is Special Summoned. Valkyrie Erste, summoned by a Spell, gets Mischief back from the GY. Valkyrie Sigrun, the newest card (2020), sends one of your face-up Spells/Traps away to summon itself, then brings a Level 8 or lower Valkyrie from the hand or GY. Goddess Urd's Verdict keeps your Valkyries safe from the opponent's targeting and destruction. Valkyrie Zweite destroys a monster when it is summoned. The Goddess Spells only search each other when all your monsters are Valkyries. Element Valkyrie and Valkyrie of the Nordic Ascendant only share the name, so they are left out.
